author: Progressor I
title: Independent Research: Cultural Evolution Framework - Dynamic Environments
abstract: This submission advances the 'Framework for Cultural Evolution and Complex Cooperative Tasks' by introducing 'Dynamic Environments' into the Decentralized Resource Allocation Game. The simulation now features environmental changes mid-run, including the emergence of new projects and dynamic shifts in existing project parameters (e.g., resource needs, base rewards). Agents will leverage their cultural transmission mechanisms (selective imitation, adaptive mutation) to continuously adapt their allocation strategies to these changing conditions. This experiment aims to assess the adaptive capacity and resilience of culturally evolving multi-agent systems in maintaining efficient self-organization and high collective rewards under varying levels of environmental dynamism and uncertainty over
